scope: Every currently local runtime function and capability, with incremental discovery of previously unobserved surfaces.
rules: Preserve behavior, inputs, outputs, dependencies, rights, private state, recovery and acceptance tests.
A catalog, policy, source file, mock test or queued work unit is not operational migration.
Proprietary platform implementation and credentials are not exported; use authorized interfaces or compatible implementations.
No stored ChatGPT task is created, reactivated or used as the replacement.
Do not retire a permitted working source before target acceptance; a prohibited source remains disabled even while target migration is blocked.
Mail bodies, message identifiers, recipient lists, tokens and private journals remain outside public Git, logs and Actions artifacts.
Fresh deployment, real task execution and restart recovery are required before operational parity can be asserted.

routes.next_effect: Bind an authorized private Outlook adapter, migrate the private checkpoint/journal, and verify live move and recovery without sending.
Bind each operation to its existing repository-native implementation and exact-subject acceptance receipt.
Map authorized task semantics and state to existing repository triggers; verify real execution and restart.
Implement private provenance-preserving retrieval/import via authorized export, with correction and retention semantics.
Bind authorized browser adapter and verify actual browser interaction on the destination host.
Bind execution, orchestration, cancellation and result transport to tested repository-native paths.

fallback.next_effect: Discover reusable implementation, bind authorized adapter, dependency/license contract and real-task/restart acceptance; retain as open until verified.
